description: Music-aware Geometry Dash gameplay generation research tools.

training-difficulty-override.name: Training Difficulty Override
training-difficulty-override.description: Difficulty label written into gameplay exports. Leave on Auto when the copied level keeps its rating metadata; set this manually for batches if it does not.
